requirements_summary: Scale: index ~18M docs initially, expected growth to 60M+ over 12 months; average doc size 120KB; expect 5-10x index expansion for embeddings/metadata.
Latency: 95th p95 rerank end-to-end (embed + ANN + cross-encoder) target < 300ms; p50 < 120ms for common queries.
Throughput: steady-state 200 qps with 2x burst handling up to 2k qps during discovery events.
Cost per query: target average <$0.15 for typical rerank flow; will accept higher for high-sensitivity cases but expect optimization guidance.
Observability: token-level cost breakouts per request, audit log exports, immutable retention controls, search query provenance tracing.
Fallbacks: automatic routing to cheaper approximate model for non-sensitive corpora; strict policy to forbid fallback to hosted variants for regulated datasets.
Data residency & retention: primary index in customer VPC region (us-east-1), cold archive on-prem with 7+ year retention and legal hold flagging.
Security: SAML SSO, org-scoped keys (KMS/HSM), SOC2 evidence or compensating controls required for procurement approval.
Deployment: prefer Redwood Private (VPC) with dedicated GPU cluster for cross-encoder rerank; Evaluate on-prem bundle if VPC connectivity latency > 40ms.
